name: Endure
overview: Scripture teaches that enduring in faith until the end is essential for salvation, as Jesus promises in Matthew 24:13. Believers are encouraged to find peace and courage in Christ’s gift, not the world’s, to prevent their hearts from being troubled or afraid (John 14:27). The Apostle Paul reminds us that God works all things together for good for those who love Him and calls us to rely on His strength and power (Romans 8:28; Ephesians 6:10). Through the Holy Spirit, believers are filled with joy and hope, enabling them to persevere by the power Christ provides (Romans 15:13; Philippians 4:13).
